evidence.excerpt: I just got into YC S26 as a 40yo solo founder. Did YC W20 with Upflow, was CTO/CPO for 6 years. Company is doing millions in ARR and still growing. But I’m a maker at heart, so I left to go 0-1 again. Last year I built an MCP gateway with a friend. MCP servers are notoriously insecure, so I wrote a CLI to run them inside VMs. There was pull on the gateway, but I wasn’t passionate about the problem. I loved the CLI though, so I pivoted, and started selling it to friends. They loved it too. It…
